messages:
maya: FYI streaming connections to /v1/streams started failing for clients behind corp proxy after CA rotation. Root error: TLS cert verify failed.

dan: @maya can you paste the error and SDK version?

maya: Node SDK v4.1.2, error snippet:
```
Error: certificate has expired
    at TLSSocket.onConnectSecure (_tls_wrap.js:... )
    at TLSSocket.emit (events.js:...)
    at TLSSocket._finishInit (_tls_wrap.js:...)
caUsed: /etc/ssl/corp.pem
```

maya: We mount the corp CA at /etc/ssl/corp.pem and pass it into the SDK via:
```js
const api = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, tls: { ca: fs.readFileSync('/etc/ssl/corp.pem') } })
```

julia: Sounds like a classic MITM CA rotation. If the proxy is terminating TLS (i.e. not doing CONNECT) the client needs the proxy's CA in its truststore. Node often needs NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS set or the CA bundled into the OS store.

sre-oncall: +1. Also confirm whether the proxy is using CONNECT (tunnel) or intercepting. CONNECT keeps end-to-end TLS and you shouldn't need to add CA. Intercepting proxies present their own certs.

leo: For streams we see partial frames when the TLS connection fails mid-stream. Our retry path retries the HTTP request but the caller expects idempotent stream resume; that's a separate UX bug.

maya: Quick workaround for the customer: export NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/etc/ssl/corp.pem && restart the process. That fixed their failures immediately.

dan: Another option: set HTTPS_PROXY or use an http-proxy-agent that does CONNECT if the proxy supports tunneling. That avoids MITM entirely.

julia: Proposal: add support in SDK to read REDWOOD_CA_FILE env var automatically and surface a clearer error message when TLS verify fails, e.g. 'stream tls verify failed: check NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS or REDWOOD_CA_FILE'. Also add doc under devex explaining proxy types and recommended env settings.

build-bot: deploy/canary: merged patch refactor/sdk-ca-env r=dan, canary SDK build 2026-03-15T22:34:12Z

maya: Filed follow-up bug #1347 to track docs + robust stream reconnect behavior. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: If anyone sees pods still failing after NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS update, ping me and I'll check kube mounts and ConfigMap mounts for the CA file.
